summary: Tested the Rider, Admin and Seller-photo features on both the backend and the mobile web preview (375x667). Backend: test_rider_admin.py, test_seller.py and test_smoke.py pass when run as scripts and as pytest. The new test_admin_config_validation.py passes 5/5: the API rejects out-of-range fees with 422. In the UI these all work: login mode links change the title; admin login with 9999900000 lands on /admin; any other number in admin mode shows 'This number is not authorised for admin access'; Admin overview shows 11 metrics and 2 pending cards that link to their tabs; Shops chips and review sheet approve/reject work (reject without a note shows a validation message); Riders verify works; Fees save persists after reload and was restored; the rider flow works end to end (job accept, Deliveries list, Confirm pickup, wrong OTP shows a toast, correct OTP marks delivered, profile history shows 1 · ₹29); the Seller Shop tab has no DEMO button and shows 'Live for customers'; the storefront and product photo pickers render, and a real web file upload shows a preview; the customer seller page loads the product image from /api/files/...; role redirects work (rider: / and /admin go to /rider; admin: /rider and /partner go to /admin; customer: /admin goes to /). Found and fixed one bug: after a new rider submitted onboarding, the app sent them back to an empty onboarding form. Remaining issues: an empty Fees field saves as 0; a rejected shop's status title says 'Pending review'; 'Delivered · back to jobs' stacks a second tabs navigator; a ROUTE_NAMES_CHANGED dev error appears on cross-role redirects. No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected.

minor.issue: Each file passes on its own, and the whole suite passes serially (-p no:xdist). Under xdist, test_seller_extended::test_ready_then_rider_and_otp and ::test_batch fail with KeyError 'id', and later runs also hit Errno 99 'Cannot assign requested address' (local ports running out because every call opens a new connection without requests.Session). Uvicorn WatchFiles also reloads the backend when files under backend/tests change, which drops connections mid-run.
Collection error: it requires the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (KeyError), unlike the other files, which use API.

ui_bugs.issue: Clearing a field and saving sends Number('') = 0. commission_pct was saved as 0 without any warning (restored to 15 via API). There is no client-side check for empty or non-numeric values. Reference: app/admin/(tabs)/fees.tsx:34

A rejected shop still shows the title 'Pending review' with an hourglass, while the body says 'FSSAI: rejected' and gives the reason. The title should say 'Not approved' and the card should offer a way to fix and resubmit. Reference: app/partner/(tabs)/shop.tsx:58

router.replace('/rider') from the order screen inside the rider Stack puts a second (tabs) navigator on the stack. After the tap, two rider-tab-index elements are in the DOM, one hidden. Use router.back() or router.dismissTo('/rider'). Reference: app/rider/order/[id].tsx:73
A logged-in rider who opens /login sees the login form instead of being sent to their role home.

integration_issues.flow: Rider onboarding -> Jobs (FIXED by testing agent)
integration_issues.issue: After the onboarding POST returned 200, the app went to /rider and then straight back to an empty /rider/onboarding form. Cause: invalidateQueries does not refetch inactive queries, so RiderTabs read the stale cached {rider:null} and redirected again. Fixed with qc.setQueryData(['rider-me'], {rider}), the same approach partner/onboarding already uses. Retested: lands on /rider with the pending banner and the online switch disabled.

issues: PartnerHeader shows the eyebrow 'GATHRCART PARTNER' on the Admin and Rider apps. It should read e.g. 'GATHRCART ADMIN' or 'GATHRCART RIDER'.

A red dev error toast appears: "The action 'ROUTE_NAMES_CHANGED' ... was not handled by any navigator". It shows when an admin opens /rider or /partner and is redirected through '/'. It is dev-only noise but visible.

action_items: Fees form: validate that each field is non-empty and numeric before saving, and do not turn '' into 0 (fees.tsx save()).
partner/(tabs)/shop.tsx: give rejected shops their own state ('Not approved' plus the reason and a resubmit path).
rider/order/[id].tsx: replace router.replace('/rider') with router.dismissTo('/rider') or router.back() so a second tabs navigator is not stacked.
Change the PartnerHeader eyebrow text per role (admin / rider).
Make tests stable under xdist: use requests.Session, and fix the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL dependency in test_gathrcart_extended.py.
Optional: redirect logged-in users away from /login.
critical_code_review_comments: rider/onboarding.tsx had the stale-cache redirect loop (now fixed). Check any other screen that calls invalidateQueries and then navigates to a layout that gates on the same query.
PhotoPicker uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env, checks permissions first, and handles errors; a web upload worked.
No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) and no SafeAreaView imports from react-native.

success_rate.backend: 100% (each file run alone, and the full suite serially); full suite under xdist is flaky
success_rate.frontend: ~88% (requested flows pass after the onboarding fix; 4 minor UI issues open)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend scripts with API=http://localhost:8001/api. To create a fresh ready_for_pickup order with an uploaded photo, run: API=http://localhost:8001/api python tests/seed_rider_admin_ui.py (writes /tmp/ui_seed.json with order id and OTP). Review sheets slide in, so wait about 2s, then use JS click (evaluate e=>e.click()) on the sheet buttons. The admin pending card testIDs are admin-pending-sellers_pending and admin-pending-riders_pending. Run test_admin_config_validation.py on its own because it changes global config.
rca_of_issue: Rider onboarding bounce: rider/(tabs)/_layout.tsx redirects when rider-me.data.rider is null. On the onboarding screen the tabs layout is unmounted, so its query is inactive. invalidateQueries only refetches active queries, so the cache still held {rider:null}. On router.replace('/rider') the layout rendered from that stale cache and immediately sent the user back to onboarding, a fresh mount with empty fields. Fix: write the POST response into the cache with setQueryData before navigating.
